reviewer: Single project-agent source review, performed before training and held generations; not independent human annotation.
primary: Keep the published gold, both formats and all 24 original questions unchanged in the registered analysis.
sensitivity: Also report exact-normalized match to the fixed variants and paired differences on the 20 directly supported questions. Evaluate all actual callback milestones and final answers separately. For first-token and elapsed-time intervals resample whole sources separately in human, linked, wheel, agenda and retention families, 20,000 replicates, seed 670032. Retention cluster labels are reused across its two table presentations.
reading: One predetermined presentation per question, exactly 12 of each. Blind both answers and source evidence to model identity and aggregate scores. Rate each visible answer as equivalent, incomplete, contradicted, appropriately qualified, or absent. Mark explicit hallucinated claims. Record independently whether source retrieval succeeded. Publish raw ratings and expose limited reviewer independence. No reranking or credit in the registered decision.
